verdict.rationale: vLLM docs explicitly claim 200+ HuggingFace model architectures supported, including Transformers backend fallback for arbitrary HF models, and community corroboration cites its 'huge model library including low precision' as a key strength. Docs also reference broad hardware/quantization support underpinning multi-modal and MoE model serving, though embedding-model and exact MoE/multi-modal breakdowns aren't itemized in this pack. Missing for 10: explicit enumeration of embedding-model support and named multi-modal model examples, independent hands-on verification of the 200+ figure.
